name: Joachim Streit - Après le § 5 - Am 11
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2025
part_text: 5a. Stresses that the EIB must operate strictly as a complementary instrument of last resort, intervening only where genuine market failures exist and where private capital cannot be mobilised on its own; warns against any expansion of the EIB’s mandate or financing volumes that would crowd out private investment or be a substitute for Member States’ own investment decisions;
